attackers_goals: Collect information about the host, network and user configuration for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
description: Using psinfo.exe, the attacker can gather information about the network, and gain an in-depth understanding of which devices are relevant to attack.
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow. Verify that this isn't sanctioned IT activity. Look for other hosts executing similar commands.
name: System information discovery via psinfo.exe
